tools.name: quote_swap
tools.description: Live THORChain quote for swapping XRP to BTC, ETH or USDC: expected amount out, every fee (ours is 0.5%), minimum size and expiry. Screens the destination against the OFAC list. Read-only; builds nothing.

tools.name: build_swap_tx
tools.description: Re-quotes and returns ONE unsigned XRP Ledger Payment to THORChain that the caller signs and submits with its own wallet. Same checks as swap.botgraph.org: OFAC screen on both addresses, minimum enforced, memo in MemoData only, no DestinationTag, LastLedgerSequence before the quote expiry. We never

tools.name: swap_status
tools.description: Outcome of a swap by its XRP Ledger transaction hash: XRP payment validated, THORChain observed it, swapping, coins sent (with outbound hashes), or refunded.
